gloss: waxing and waning (of the moon); phases of the moon

definitions.gloss: waxing and waning (of the moon); lunar phases
definitions.explanation: The monthly cycle in which the moon grows from new to full and shrinks again. {満|み}ちる (to become full) + {欠|か}ける (to become chipped, wane).

examples.japanese: ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満|み}ち{欠|か}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To observe the phases of the moon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{満|み}ち{引|ひ}き→満ち引き：32283_michihiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満|み}ち{欠|か}け⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The ebb and flow of the tides is related to the phases of the moon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満|み}ち{欠|か}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もとにした⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In old Japan, a calendar based on the phases of the moon was used.

notes:

- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満|み}ち{欠|か}け: the phases of the moon
